findings.passage: Only _Whalefall_, for which he auditioned, was plainly his choice.
findings.problem: The criterion does not separate the two films. The same IndieWire interview (S15, 2024-09-27, re-opened) quoted in the preceding sentence says of Wolfs: "it was a standard audition and then meeting with Jon." He auditioned for both. The real difference is what he knew: he auditioned for Wolfs having seen only the interrogation scene, while Whalefall's exposure is its premise. C124's inference and S15's excerpt omit the Wolfs audition.
findings.acceptance_test: The sentence rests the distinction on what he knew when he pursued each part (for example, "He auditioned for Wolfs having seen only the interrogation scene; Whalefall, whose premise is the exposure, was plainly his choice."), or otherwise stops implying that Whalefall alone came through an audition. C124's inference and S15's excerpt record the "standard audition" line.

findings.problem: The Italian Rêve (S07, 2024-09-04) is quoted four times (people and writing; deferring to Clooney and Pitt; "be yourself"/"noise"; the lone-wolf answer) and appears in citations, but it is never linked in the body. findings.acceptance_test: The first quoted Italian Rêve passage links to https://www.theitalianreve.com/interview-with-austin-abrams-whatever-happens-we-play-the-truth/ with its date (September 4, 2024).

findings.passage: In 2024 he urged actors to "be yourself and not whom you think other people want you to be," since "everything is noise."
findings.problem: Two paraphrases slightly strengthen their sources. In S07 the line is a reflection that includes himself ("especially in what we, actors, do... remember what's important, like being goofy sometimes and be yourself"), not an exhortation to other actors. Separately, "A friend talked Abrams into seeing Cregger's Barbarian" dramatizes S09's "I wasn't super excited going into it. But my friend wanted to go, and I was like, 'sure, I'll go.'" Neither changes the argument.
findings.acceptance_test: The first sentence frames the line as his reflection on what actors, himself included, should remember (for example, "In 2024 he said actors like him should remember..."). The Barbarian sentence says a friend wanted to go and he went along without much excitement. C35 and C66 are updated to match.
